water_chart.title: Water Consumption
water_chart.load_failed: Water history could not be loaded.

environment_chart.keyboard_scrub_instructions: Use the Left and Right Arrow keys to move through readings. Home and End jump to the window edges. Escape clears the reading.

tasks.arrange_instructions: Move plants into their new cells. Changes stay on this card until you choose Done.
tasks.compare_instructions: Choose 2–4 readings for one Metric Comparison.
tasks.select_plants_instructions: Choose plants, then use a bulk action. Bulk actions save immediately.
tasks.delete_comparison_confirmation: Delete {comparison}? This removes the saved comparison.
tasks.arrange_unavailable: Arrange requires atomic layout support and at least one possible move.
tasks.compare_unavailable: Compare requires at least two visible readings with backing entities.
tasks.arrange_entered: Arrange started. Move plants, then choose Done or Cancel.
tasks.select_entered: Select plants started. Plant activation now changes the selection.
tasks.layout_stale: The layout changed elsewhere. Reload the layout or cancel.
tasks.layout_save_failed: Arrangement could not be saved. Review the error and try again.
tasks.plant_picked_up: Picked up {plant}. Use arrow keys to choose a cell, then press Space or Enter to place it.
tasks.empty_cell_location: Empty cell, row {row}, column {col}. Pick up a plant before choosing this target.
tasks.arrange_empty_target: Empty Arrange target, row {row}, column {col}. Press Space or Enter to place the picked-up plant.
tasks.arrange_plant_label: {plant}, row {row}, column {col}. Press Space or Enter to pick up this plant for Arrange.
tasks.arrange_picked_plant_label: {plant}, picked up from row {row}, column {col}. Use arrow keys to choose a target, then press Space or Enter to place it.
tasks.arrange_plant_target_label: {plant}, Arrange target in row {row}, column {col}. Press Space or Enter to place or swap the picked-up plant.
tasks.plant_returned: Returned {plant} to row {row}, column {col}. The arrangement is unchanged.
tasks.plants_swapped: Moved {plant} to row {row}, column {col} and swapped with {other}.
tasks.comparison_save_failed: The Metric Comparison could not be saved. Review the latest readings and try again.
tasks.comparison_delete_failed: The Metric Comparison could not be deleted. Review the latest comparisons and try again.
tasks.comparison_conflict: Metric comparisons changed in another tab. Review the latest groups and try again.
tasks.comparison_limit: A Metric Comparison contains 2 to 4 readings.
tasks.comparison_claimed: That reading already belongs to another Metric Comparison.
tasks.comparison_session_only: Metric Comparisons are available for this session only because durable, conflict-safe browser storage is unavailable.
tasks.compare_entered_after_prune_one: Compare started. Removed {count} reading from saved Metric Comparisons because it was unavailable or left a group too small.
tasks.compare_entered_after_prune_other: Compare started. Removed {count} readings from saved Metric Comparisons because they were unavailable or left a group too small.
tasks.comparison_prune_failed: Saved Metric Comparisons could not be checked against the available readings. Try Compare again.

config.environment_requires_growspace: Select a growspace before saving the environment.
config.environment_requires_temperature_and_hum: Temperature and humidity sensors are required.
config.environment_requires_moisture_band: Set both healthy moisture bounds, or clear both to use the defaults.
config.critical_temperature_description: Below low the fan runs at minimum speed, above high it runs at maximum speed, and leaving both empty disables this safety cutoff.
config.critical_temperature_already_disabled: This safety cutoff is already disabled.

editor.no_growspaces: No growspaces found — configure the growspace_manager integration first.

vision.section_help: One ledger per camera capture: what the camera saw on the left, what the sensors measured on the right, and the one band where both are named.
vision.empty_body: Run a checkup, or wait for the next scheduled window. Each capture is kept and shown, including the ones that could not be analysed.
vision.load_failed: Vision evidence could not be loaded.
vision.scope_line: Growspace Vision compares this camera to its own recent history. It does not assess plant health, and it does not diagnose symptoms.
vision.calibration_line: Baseline State describes only whether this camera has enough recent history to compare against.
vision.service_model_unknown: Connected, but the service reported no model.
vision.service_reason_not_installed: The Growspace Vision App is not installed.
vision.service_reason_not_running: The Growspace Vision App is installed but not running.
vision.service_reason_unreachable: The Vision endpoint did not respond.
vision.service_reason_schema_mismatch: The service speaks a schema version this integration does not support.
vision.service_reason_model_unavailable: The pinned model is not available on the service.
vision.service_reason_unknown: The integration did not report a reason.
vision.service_stale_note: Evidence below was recorded earlier and is still shown; it is not live.
vision.checkup_status_note: Describes how the checkup task ran, not what it found.
vision.checkup_no_verdict: One result per camera. A checkup has no combined cross-camera verdict.
vision.continuity_title: Capture Continuity Break — check the equipment
vision.continuity_detail: {count} consecutive scheduled captures could not be compared ({reasons}), since {since}.
vision.continuity_note: This names no cause and no plant condition.
vision.gate_kept: The capture is kept and shown; it is never silently dropped.
vision.quality_reason_below_absolute_luminance_: Too dark to analyse — mean luminance below the absolute floor of 16. Usually lights-off.
vision.quality_reason_relative_detail_collapse: Detail fell below half of this camera's recent typical level.
vision.quality_reason_exposure_excursion: Brightness landed outside 0.5–2.0× this camera's recent typical level.
vision.visual_column_note: Compared only against this camera's own recent frames. Receives no sensor data of any kind.
vision.visual_image_unavailable: The stored frame is no longer available.
vision.verdict_normal_gloss: This frame sits inside the spread of this camera's own recent accepted frames.
vision.verdict_normal_caveat: Not a health check — a visibly unhealthy plant can score here.
vision.verdict_uncertain_gloss: This frame is near the edge of that spread. Too close to call either way.
vision.verdict_uncertain_caveat: Held as monitor. No conclusion is drawn from a single borderline frame.
vision.verdict_material_scene_change_gloss: This frame is further from this camera's recent history than every frame in its baseline.
vision.verdict_material_scene_change_caveat: Says the scene changed — a moved camera, a light change, a harvest. It cannot tell those apart, and it is not a plant verdict.
vision.verdict_unknown_gloss: A comparison ran but the service returned no verdict for it.
vision.verdict_unknown_caveat: Absence of a verdict is not a normal reading.
vision.rank_partial: Further from this camera's recent history than {rank} of the {total} frames in its baseline.
vision.rank_all: Further from this camera's recent history than all {total} frames in its baseline.
vision.confidence_clear: Clear of the borderline band ({separation} separation).
vision.confidence_close: Close to the borderline band ({separation} separation).
vision.visual_silent_note: This column is silent. A silent column is not a normal reading.
vision.numbers_note: The Anomaly Score is a rank against this camera's own recent accepted frames. It is not a probability, and it carries no information about plant health.
vision.trend_label: Anomaly Score of the {count} comparable captures before this one, oldest first
vision.env_column_note: Evaluated from environmental readings alone. Never shown to the camera model or to the image pass.
vision.env_risk_gloss: One or more environmental evaluations are active.
vision.env_within_evaluated_range_gloss: Fresh evaluations completed and none is active.
vision.env_unavailable_gloss: No fresh evaluation could be made for this capture.
vision.env_unavailable_caveat: Unavailable is not fine. A zero probability from zero observations is no evidence at all.
vision.env_history_empty: No evaluated history for this camera yet.
vision.env_history_summary_one: {count} evaluated capture · amber marks an active risk
vision.env_history_summary_other: {count} evaluated captures · amber marks an active risk
vision.env_never_visual: Environmental risk on its own is never a report of visible plant stress.
vision.fusion_no_detected_change_gloss: Complete evidence from both channels found neither environmental risk nor a material departure from recent scene history.
vision.fusion_no_detected_change_caveat: This means both channels stayed quiet. It is not a clean bill of health.
vision.fusion_environmental_risk_gloss: The sensors flagged risk. The camera did not see a material scene change.
vision.fusion_environmental_risk_caveat: Environmental risk on its own is never a report of visible plant stress.
vision.fusion_visual_anomaly_gloss: The camera saw a material departure from recent scene history. The sensors did not flag risk.
vision.fusion_visual_anomaly_caveat: A scene departure, not a symptom. No cause is named.
vision.fusion_concurrent_environmental_risk_and: Both channels reported something in the same window.
Co-occurrence only. Neither channel explains the other, and no causal link is claimed.
vision.fusion_persistent_visual_anomaly_gloss: The camera has reported a material scene departure across repeated captures.
vision.fusion_persistent_visual_anomaly_caveat: Describes persistence and fusion precedence — not danger to the plant.
vision.fusion_none_caveat: An absent outcome is not a quiet one.
vision.fusion_coverage_partial_note: Partial coverage: at least one channel could not speak for this capture.
vision.reason_frame_rejected: the frame was not usable, so there was nothing to compare
vision.reason_analysis_pending: the analysis has not finished yet
vision.reason_vision_unavailable: the Vision service could not be reached
vision.reason_visual_comparison_unavailable: there is no Visual Comparison Result to fuse
vision.reason_environmental_evidence_unavailabl: there is no environmental evaluation to fuse
vision.report_summary: Optional cloud explanation — generated text, may disagree with the columns above
vision.report_note: Two passes that cannot see each other's inputs. This prose is an explanation of the evidence above, never a replacement for it, and never a diagnosis.
vision.legacy_note: A frozen cloud-era result. Its severity and issues are historical attribution only; they are not V1 fusion evidence and are not restyled as any.

tc.incompatible_body: This TC installation does not provide any features supported by this card. Check that Growspace Manager TC and this card are compatible and up to date, then reload the page.
tc.editor_note: Nothing to configure. This card shows your tissue culture lines when the Growspace Manager TC integration is set up, and hides itself when it is not.
tc.medium_library_empty: No culture media yet. Add one to record what your cultures grow on.
tc.medium_history_explainer: Editing a medium records a new version. Earlier versions are kept exactly as they were, because platings pin the version they were poured from.
tc.medium_will_fork: Saving records a new version. The current one is kept unchanged.
tc.medium_will_not_fork: Nothing in the formulation changed, so saving records no new version.
tc.medium_delete_confirm: Delete “{name}”? Its {count} recorded versions go with it, and nothing can bring them back.
tc.board_empty: No culture lines yet. Introduce a phenotype to start one.
tc.line_relink_explainer: Pick the phenotype this line should point at. It was referencing “{name}”.
tc.line_missing_phenotype: The phenotype this line references is no longer in your strain library. “{name}” is the name it had when the line was started. Re-link it to another phenotype, or archive the line — nothing is deleted either way.
tc.picker_library_empty: Your strain library has no phenotypes to reference yet. Add one in the strain library first.
tc.picker_more_matches: {count} more match. Keep typing to narrow the list.
tc.introduction_explainer: An introduction starts a culture line and its first vessel in one act.
tc.introduction_intervals_explainer: How long a culture may sit on one medium, per stage. These are your protocol, so there is no default worth trusting — change them to match yours.
tc.worklist_explainer: Every vessel by the day its line says it needs fresh medium. Overdue first.
tc.worklist_empty: Nothing is due. Every vessel still has time on the medium it is on.
tc.action_replate_explainer: The first vessel is this culture, replated: it keeps its identity and its history. Every further vessel is a new culture the division creates.
tc.action_discard_explainer: The vessel stays in your history, ended. Nothing is deleted.
tc.action_note_explainer: Recorded against this vessel. Nothing else changes.
tc.action_graduate_explainer: End this culture and keep its history. You can optionally create one plant in Growspace Manager.
tc.action_medium_none: No culture medium to pour from yet. Add one in the medium library first — a replate has to pin the version it was poured from.
tc.action_note_required: A note has to say something.
tc.history_empty: Nothing recorded against this vessel yet.
tc.history_replate_divided: Replated onto {medium}, version {version}, divided into {count} vessels
tc.history_medium_unknown: a medium no longer in the library
tc.action_move_to_rooting_explainer: The rooting interval starts applying to the same last replate. The vessel stays on the medium it is already on.
tc.pairing_body: Record which phenotypes suit a culture medium, with your notes. Pairings apply across all versions of the medium.
tc.pairing_duplicate: This phenotype already has a pairing with this culture medium. Edit the existing pairing instead.
tc.pairing_needs_medium: Add a culture medium to the library before creating a pairing.
tc.pairing_empty: No pairings yet. Add an endorsement to start your collection.
tc.pairing_missing_phenotype: Missing phenotype. Edit this pairing to choose a replacement, or remove it.
tc.graduation_create_plant: Create a plant in Growspace Manager
tc.graduation_bridge_help: Creates one plant in the clone stage. Confirm the genetics and an empty position. If creation fails, the culture still graduates.
tc.graduation_no_growspace: No growspace is available for a new plant. You can still record the graduation.
tc.graduation_growspaces_loading: Looking for somewhere to put the plant…
tc.graduation_growspaces_failed: Growspace Manager did not answer, so its growspaces are unknown. You can still record the graduation.
tc.graduation_unlinked: Culture graduated, but no plant was linked. Check Growspace Manager before adding a plant manually.

labels.read_only: A read-only look at the label layouts this integration ships. Each preview below is the bitmap the printer would receive, rendered by Home Assistant — not a drawing of it.
labels.classic_body: This Growspace Manager integration does not offer label templates. Label printing continues to work through the existing print dialogs.
labels.incompatible_body: This card cannot use the label template contract this integration published. The template features stay unavailable; the existing print dialogs are unaffected. Update Growspace Manager and this card to a matching pair, then reload the page.
labels.preview_unprofiled: No preview: no printer this product has characterised can render this label size yet.
labels.preview_failed: The preview could not be fetched: {reason}
labels.preview_no_raster: The integration could not render this template. Its diagnostics say why.
labels.preview_alt: Rendered preview of the {template} label template
labels.state_unprofiled_detail: This label size is catalogued and has a factory template, but no characterised printer can render it. Nothing can be previewed or printed from a template at this size.
labels.state_provisional_detail: The preview is exactly what this printer would receive. The profile has not been verified against physical prints, so it may produce test labels but not production ones.
labels.state_verified_detail: This printer profile has physical evidence behind it, but this installation has no current calibration. Calibration and test labels are available; production printing is not.
labels.state_production_detail: This printer profile is verified and calibrated for this installation. Labels printed from a template here are the ones the product claims support for.
labels.editor_nudge_hint: Arrow keys move 0.5 mm; hold Shift for 2 mm. Positions are in millimetres on the paper, so they do not change with browser zoom.
labels.editor_nothing_selected: Select an element on the canvas to edit its position and size.
labels.editor_raster_alt: The bitmap this printer would receive for the saved draft
labels.editor_raster_absent: No preview has been rendered for this draft yet.
labels.editor_raster_settled: The preview below is exactly what this printer would receive for the layout shown.
labels.editor_raster_stale: The outlines have moved since this preview was rendered. It is a picture of the previous layout, not of the one shown.
labels.editor_blocked_unsaved: Waiting for the last change to be saved.
labels.editor_blocked_invalid: This layout cannot be published yet. The reasons are listed under Selection.
labels.editor_blocked_stale: Somebody else published this template while this draft was open. Your work is kept; load the saved version to see what changed.
labels.editor_blocked_unnamed: Give the template a name before publishing it.
labels.editor_raster_failed: This integration could not render a preview of the saved draft. Its diagnostics say why. The layout can still be saved and published — a template is millimetres on paper, and which printer renders it is decided later.
labels.editor_blocked_stale_preview: Waiting for a preview of the current layout. Publishing against an older picture would mean approving something nobody has seen.
labels.editor_snap_on: Snapping on: edges and centres pull into line.
labels.editor_snap_off: Snapping off: nothing pulls into line.
labels.editor_zoom_fit: Fit the label to the canvas
labels.editor_keyboard_hint: Arrow keys move the selection by 0.5 mm and Shift by 2 mm. Ctrl+D duplicates, Delete removes, [ and ] change the paint order, Ctrl+A selects everything, Escape selects nothing, and Ctrl+Z undoes. Every one of those is also a control on this screen.
labels.editor_announce_moved: Moved {x} mm across and {y} mm down.
labels.editor_announce_duplicated: Duplicated {count} elements. The copies are now selected.
labels.editor_announce_deleted_required: Deleted the strain-name element. The layout cannot be published without one; undo brings it back.
labels.editor_announce_added: Added a {kind} element, and selected it.
labels.editor_announce_no_binding: No content this integration catalogues can fill a {kind} element, so none was added.
labels.editor_announce_reset: Layout returned to the version opened in this session. Undo is available.
labels.editor_selection_many: {count} selected. The controls below edit the {kind} you picked last.
labels.editor_rotation_fixed: Rotated {degrees}°. This printer profile places elements upright only, so there is nothing to choose.
labels.editor_content_asset: An image this integration stores. It is chosen outside the editor.
labels.editor_binding_unknown: This element is bound to {id}, which this card does not recognise. It is left exactly as it is.
labels.editor_style_font_floor: This printer cannot render text below {floor} mm legibly, and is comfortable from {comfort} mm.
labels.editor_style_overflow: When the text does not fit
labels.editor_overflow_shrink_ellipsis: Shrink, then end with an ellipsis
labels.editor_mono_dither: Dither — grain, closer to the original tones
labels.editor_style_fit_fixed: Version 1 of the layout language has one fit, so this is a fact rather than a choice.
labels.editor_style_quiet_zone_floor: This printer needs at least {modules} modules of quiet zone, and encodes at most {bytes} bytes.
labels.editor_style_divider_floor: This printer cannot be relied on to lay ink thinner than {thickness} mm. A divider's thickness is its height, in the size controls above.
labels.editor_multi_select_on: Selecting multiple: tapping an element adds it to the selection.
labels.editor_multi_select_off: Selecting one: tapping an element selects only it.
labels.library_empty: No Named Templates for this Label Size yet. Create a blank draft, or edit the Factory layout to start from it.
labels.library_stale: The saved template has changed. Save As preserves this draft under a new identity; reload starts from the current revision.
labels.library_orphaned: The template was deleted. This draft can be inspected, exported, discarded or saved as a new template.
labels.library_ownership: Only your own drafts appear here. Other administrators cannot take over your work.
labels.library_quarantined: This template cannot currently be printed. Inspect or export the original data, restore a valid revision, or replace its layout from Factory.
labels.library_portable: Portable export shares current published Named Templates only. It excludes drafts, history, defaults and deleted templates. It is not a full integration backup. Use Home Assistant backups to preserve the whole integration.
labels.library_as_copy: Import as a copy with a fresh identity
labels.library_admin: Managing Label Templates requires a Home Assistant administrator.
labels.library_newer_store: This library requires a newer integration. Nothing has been changed. Upgrade Growspace Manager; detected / supported store versions:
labels.library_opaque: This draft contains data this card cannot edit losslessly. Its original recovery data was exported. Upgrade the card and integration before editing.
labels.library_save_first: Local edits are not saved. Export your recovery data or reload the server draft before Save As.
labels.library_retry_same: The result could not be confirmed. Retry this same action to recover its result safely.
labels.library_rename_effect: Append a revision with the new name. Identity and history remain unchanged; existing drafts may become stale.
labels.library_duplicate_effect: Copy the current saved revision into a new identity. Unpublished draft edits are not included.
labels.library_save_as_effect: Publish this work under a new identity. In the editor, the reviewed local layout is used and the server draft is retained for recovery. From the draft list, the stored draft is consumed only after successful publication. The original template is unchanged.
labels.library_set_default_effect: Use this template for this Label Size. Future default selections follow its current saved revision.
labels.library_clear_default_effect: Remove the custom default override and use the installed Factory fallback for this Label Size.
labels.library_delete_effect: Remove this Named Template from selection for up to 30 days. Its identity and history remain recoverable; existing drafts become orphaned and its default falls back atomically.
labels.library_restore_effect: Restore the same template identity and history. Choose another name if the old one is taken. Restoration does not reclaim default status.
labels.library_restore_revision_effect: Append historical content as a new head revision. Intervening history remains unchanged.
labels.library_replace_factory_effect: Replace your unpublished layout with the current Factory layout for this Label Size. Saved identity, name and history stay unchanged until you publish. The previous draft is retained as recovery data.
labels.library_reload_effect: Start from the current saved revision. The stored draft is retained as recovery data; export any unsaved local edits first.
labels.library_discard_effect: Remove your unpublished draft. Published revisions remain unchanged. Export recovery data first if you may need it.
labels.library_import_effect: Commit every checked template atomically. Resolve all conflicts first. Drafts and defaults are unchanged.
labels.editor_blocked_read_only: This draft is read-only. Export its recovery data or restore access before editing.
labels.editor_blocked_conflict: Another client saved first. Reload or export your work.
labels.editor_diagnostics_changed: This label now has {errors} blocking problems and {warnings} warnings.
labels.editor_diagnostics_clear: No problems remain on this label.
labels.editor_publish_first: Publish this template first. A production label prints from a published revision, never from a draft.
labels.editor_raster_rendering: Rendering the preview of this layout…
labels.editor_raster_slow: The preview is taking longer than usual. Your work is saved; the picture will follow.
labels.diagnostic_document_missing_required_str: The label must show the strain name. Add a text element bound to it.
labels.diagnostic_document_unknown_label_size: This layout is for a label size this installation does not know.
labels.diagnostic_content_missing_required: A required value is empty for this record, so the label cannot be printed for it.
labels.diagnostic_content_missing_optional: An optional value is empty for this record. The element is left blank.
labels.diagnostic_content_unknown_binding: This element shows a value this integration does not provide. Choose another.
labels.diagnostic_content_invalid_literal: This fixed text cannot be printed as entered.
labels.diagnostic_content_logo_unusable: The breeder logo could not be used, so the logo element is left blank.
labels.diagnostic_content_qr_target_unavailable: The address this QR code should open is not available, so the code is left out.
labels.diagnostic_content_stage_date_missing: This record has no stage date, so its age cannot be shown.
labels.diagnostic_content_stage_date_in_future: This record's stage date is in the future, so its age is not shown.
labels.diagnostic_profile_text_below_readable_f: This text is too small for this printer to print legibly. Make it larger.
labels.diagnostic_profile_text_below_comfort_th: This text is legible on this printer, but tight. Consider making it larger.
labels.diagnostic_profile_qr_below_module_floor: This QR code is too small for this printer to print scannably. Make it larger.
labels.diagnostic_profile_qr_quiet_zone_too_sma: This QR code needs a wider blank margin to scan reliably.
labels.diagnostic_profile_qr_error_correction_u: This printer has not been verified with this QR error-correction level.
labels.diagnostic_profile_qr_target_too_long: The QR code's content is longer than this printer has been verified to scan.
labels.diagnostic_profile_image_below_effective: This image is too low-resolution for the size it is printed at.
labels.diagnostic_profile_divider_below_reprodu: This divider is thinner than this printer can reliably print.
labels.diagnostic_profile_ink_outside_printable: Part of this element is outside the area this printer can reach, and will be cut off.
labels.diagnostic_profile_outside_printable_are: This element is outside the area this printer can reach.
labels.diagnostic_profile_ink_outside_safe_area: Part of this element is close to the edge, where small feed variation can clip it.
labels.diagnostic_profile_raster_wider_than_pri: This label is wider than the printer's printhead. Choose another printer profile.
labels.diagnostic_profile_stock_mismatch: This printer profile is for another label size. Choose a profile for this stock.
labels.diagnostic_profile_rotation_unsupported: This printer profile cannot rotate an element this way.
labels.diagnostic_profile_unsupported_density: This printer does not support the chosen print density.
labels.diagnostic_raster_text_does_not_fit: This text does not fit its box, even at its smallest size.
labels.diagnostic_raster_text_truncated: This text was shortened to fit. Allow more lines or a larger box to show all of it.
labels.diagnostic_raster_text_unmeasured: The font file is not installed beside the integration, so this text's exact size could not be measured. Its box stands in for its ink.
labels.diagnostic_raster_missing_glyph: This font cannot draw some characters in this text.
labels.diagnostic_raster_ink_overlap: This element's ink overlaps another element's.
labels.diagnostic_raster_qr_does_not_fit: This QR code does not fit its box. Make the box larger.
labels.diagnostic_raster_qr_not_encodable: This content cannot be encoded as a QR code.
labels.diagnostic_raster_qr_quiet_zone_violated: Another element intrudes on this QR code's blank margin, which can stop it scanning.
labels.diagnostic_raster_image_leaves_no_ink: This image prints as blank paper after conversion to black and white.
labels.diagnostic_raster_image_undecodable: This image could not be read.
labels.diagnostic_raster_render_failed: The printer integration did not render this label. Check the printer integration is installed and running, then try again.
labels.diagnostic_raster_missing: The printer integration returned no picture. Try again.
labels.diagnostic_raster_unreadable: The picture the printer integration returned could not be read. Try again.
labels.diagnostic_raster_unexpected_format: The printer integration returned a picture in an unexpected format. Try again.
labels.diagnostic_layer_document_error: The layout itself is invalid here and must be corrected.
labels.diagnostic_layer_document_warning: Part of the layout may not print as intended.
labels.diagnostic_layer_content_error: A value this label needs is missing or unusable.
labels.diagnostic_layer_content_warning: A value on this label is missing or was adjusted.
labels.diagnostic_layer_content_info: A note about the values on this label.
labels.diagnostic_layer_profile_compilation_err: This printer profile cannot reproduce this element.
labels.diagnostic_layer_profile_compilation_war: This printer profile reproduces this element, with a risk worth checking.
labels.diagnostic_layer_profile_compilation_inf: A note about how this printer reproduces the label.
labels.diagnostic_layer_raster_error: The rendered label has a problem that blocks printing.
labels.diagnostic_layer_raster_warning: The rendered label has something worth checking before printing.
labels.diagnostic_layer_raster_info: A note about the rendered label.
labels.diagnostic_layer_transport_error: The printer could not be reached. Nothing about the layout has to change; try again.
labels.diagnostic_layer_transport_warning: The printer reported a problem. Try again.
labels.refusal_generic: That could not be done. Nothing was lost; try again, or reload the saved version.
labels.refusal_preview_timeout: The preview did not arrive in time. Your draft is saved; try the preview again.
labels.refusal_transport_failed: The connection to Home Assistant was interrupted. Your work is still here; try again.
labels.refusal_draft_version_conflict: Another window saved this draft first. Your changes are kept; load the saved version to continue from it.
labels.refusal_draft_not_publishable: This layout cannot be previewed until its blocking problems are fixed.
labels.refusal_draft_not_found: This draft no longer exists. Reopen the template to continue.
labels.refusal_not_authorized: Only a Home Assistant administrator can do this.
labels.refusal_approval_expired: That preview has expired. Preview it again before printing.
labels.refusal_print_refused: The label was not printed. Every reason is listed below.
labels.refusal_calibration_sheet_not_printed: The calibration label did not print, so there is nothing to measure yet. Check the printer and try again.
labels.refusal_calibration_store_unreadable: The calibration history was written by a newer version of Growspace Manager and cannot be read here.
labels.refusal_measurement_invalid: One of the measurements cannot be right. It is marked below.
labels.refusal_printer_required: Choose the printer this label is for.
labels.refusal_unknown_profile: That printer profile is not available for this label size. Choose another.
labels.refusal_unknown_subject: That strain is not in the strain library. Choose another.
